Days Event Card Morph

Animation·by Days·2026-09-04·60fps page·original post

What it is

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: the Days event card morph - tapping the Thanksgiving card in the events list expands it seamlessly into a full-screen detail: the photo grows to fill the upper screen, the "IN 51 DAYS" countdown and "Thanksgiving" title slide into place, and swiping back down morphs it into the list row again.

Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: the Days event card morph - tapping the Thanksgiving card in the events list expands it seamlessly into a full-screen detail: the photo grows to fill the upper screen, the "IN 51 DAYS" countdown and "Thanksgiving" title slide into place, and swiping back down morphs it into the list row again.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Events list ("All events": Thanksgiving card, Christmas card below with Popular/Upcoming pills). Detail view: full-screen dark page - hero photo (pumpkin on wood) with a Share pill and close X at top, "IN 51 DAYS" over the big title and date line at bottom.

## Motion spec
Pattern: shared-element container morph.
- Tap: the card's bounds expand to full screen (spring ~340/24, 450ms); the photo scales and recrops continuously from card-crop to hero-crop (no crossfade).
- The title block slides up from the card's title position to the detail position (~60px, spring ~320/22), the "IN 51 DAYS" eyebrow fading in as it moves.
- The list behind stays visible during the morph's first half, then dims out; the Share pill and X fade in at the top (250ms, after the morph).
- Reverse: swipe down or tap X - everything plays backward, the card landing exactly in its list slot.

## Calibration
- The photo must be the same pixels throughout - a morph, not a swap.
- Corners animate too: rounded card (~16px) -> square full screen.

## Reduced motion
Crossfade between list and detail (250ms).

## Don't miss
- The morph is interruptible - a swipe down mid-expansion reverses it smoothly.
- The Christmas card stays parked below during the expansion until the dim covers it.
